title.tagline: Thin margins, costs that move on their own, and a life that does not stop when the shop closes.

1.name: Opening the Warung
1.desc: The first week of the shop. The counter and customer types.

2.name: Prices Rise
2.desc: Ingredient prices climb. The first power outage.

3.name: Busy Kitchen
3.desc: A big order from the neighborhood. Cooking and stock.

home.title: Before opening
home.dayShape: Shape of a day: before opening, shop open, free time
home.hint: If the shelves are not stocked when you open, you can still stock them while serving. Customers wait meanwhile.

siapkan.name: Prepare the shop
siapkan.desc: Full shelves, stocked fridge, prices checked. 90 minutes.

tukar.name: Exchange cash
tukar.desc: Swap big notes for small change at a shop. 30 minutes, 2% fee.

ojol.name: Drive ojol
ojol.desc: A little extra, fuel costs money.

tidur.name: Sleep in
tidur.desc: Rest longer. Stock the shelves while serving.

exchange.title: Exchange cash
exchange.help: Swap big notes from the drawer for small ones at a nearby shop. It takes {{minutes}} minutes of the pre-open block and costs {{fee}}%.

summary.title: The shop is closed. Here is how it went.
summary.notYet: No summary yet. It appears once the shop closes.

phone.title: Phone
phone.soon: Phone apps arrive in later phases: chat, bank, ojol, market, planner, ledger.

off.title: Day off
off.desc: The shop is closed. There are 4 blocks. Each holds one heavy activity or two light ones.
off.hint: Time only moves when you run a block. After the evening block comes free time, 22.00–24.00.

tomorrow.title: Open tomorrow?
tomorrow.openPlanned: The shop opens 07.00–22.00. Pre-open starts at 05.00.
tomorrow.openOnDayOff: You are working on a day off. No penalty, but no rest either.
tomorrow.closedUnplanned: Closing when it was not planned costs a little reputation, because regulars expect the shop to be open.
tomorrow.closedPlanned: A planned day off, so no penalty. Tomorrow has 4 blocks of activities.

planner.title: Weekly plan
planner.rule: At most {{max}} days off a week, no minimum. Tap a day to switch between work and off.
planner.blockHint: Dashed = heavy activity (one per block). The rest are light (two per block).

save.confirm: A new game replaces this save. The old save is kept as a backup.
save.invalid: Its data is damaged or not recognised. Starting a new game keeps it as a backup.
save.newer: This save was made by a newer version of the game. Starting a new game keeps it as a backup.
